obligations.title: Maintain administrative, technical and physical safeguards appropriate to Customer Data and industry practice.
Notify Customer of any security incident within 48 hours of becoming aware and cooperate in assessment and response.
Make Customer Data available for export for a reasonable period after termination or expiry, then delete it on written request.
Keep access credentials secure and ensure users comply with the Agreement.
Return or destroy the other party's confidential information on request after termination or expiry.
Attempt in good faith to resolve disputes through senior executive escalation before commencing proceedings.
